content.label: The question from the heart
content.question: You'll come back after studying, right?

answers.title: Be honest
answers.detail: Share your current plan honestly. Families don't like surprises.

answers.title: Plans can change
answers.detail: Jobs, rules and opportunities will shape the decision. Agree on this together from the start.

answers.title: The bond stays the same
answers.detail: Wherever you are, talk every day and call on festivals. The distance is only on the map.
